title: Operational Parameters
subtitle: Configuration of physical variables, distances, and times for operations motoring.

speed.label: Minimum Moving Speed (km/h)
speed.tooltip: Speed above which the vehicle is considered in continuous motion.

radius.label: Default Geofence Radius (meters)
radius.tooltip: Default radius applied when creating locations without a specific one.

proximity.label: Arrival Proximity (km)
proximity.tooltip: Remaining distance to destination to trigger proximity notifications.

broken_loop.label: Broken Loop Threshold (minutes)
broken_loop.tooltip: Time without GPS report to consider a signal loss (broken loop).

provider_ok.label: Provider OK Tolerance (minutes)
provider_ok.tooltip: Time margin without provider data before issuing a technical alert.
